title: Outside-contributor approval gate not documented in Mode B
reality: CONTRIBUTING.md lines 59-60: PRs authored by active Pasta-Devs organization members or owners do NOT require separate human approval, and org members with merge permission may merge a ready PR into staging. Outside and first-time contributors may submit only to staging and need an approving review from repository owner SpicyMarinara IN ADDITION to the automated gates — approval from another Pasta-Devs member does not substitute. v2.4.0 (#4361) further stopped PR description edits, CodeRabbit comments, and non-owner reviews from RECREATING that gate, while retaining refreshes for base changes and approval-relevant SpicyMarinara reviews. SKILL.md has no match for 'approval gate' or 'outside-contributor'.
fix: Add an 'Approval and merge rules' subsection to Mode B of SKILL.md. HIGH value for the skill's stated beginner audience: a first-time contributor needs to know their PR requires SpicyMarinara specifically, and that editing the PR description no longer resets that gate — which is exactly the anxiety-inducing behavior #4361 removed.

title: Playwright fixture isolation detail worth adding to the test guidance
